ValidationRule.description: Must enter Competitor Phone, Competitor Software, and Cancellation Reason information before closing case
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.ValidationSetting__c.ByPassAllValidationRules__c), NOT($Permission.skipValidation), RecordType.DeveloperName = "SWAT", ISCHANGED(Status), OR ( ISPICKVAL ( Status, "Closed Saved"), ISPICKVAL ( Status, "Closed Cancelled") ), OR( ISBLANK ( TEXT(Competitor_Phones__c)), ISBLANK ( TEXT(Competitor_Software__c)), ISBLANK ( TEXT(Cancellation_Reason__c)) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Kindly make sure that there are values in the following fields Competitor Phones, Competitor Software and Cancellation Reason before closing the case.
